summary: Source reviewer/downstream side of IF-003: independent maintainability comparison, rationale dispositions and evidence consumption, with executable local eval preparation. Shared ART-003/ART-008 remain indexed under implementer-feedback; ART-006 and IF-004 remain indexed under measurement. Live actor compliance and T-005 installed composition remain unqualified; source presence does not establish active installation parity.

provides.name: independent-original-baseline-review
provides.summary: A fresh reviewer invokes its own installation-local comparison of actual submitted changed/added/deleted Python assets against original B, including relevant test/eval/fixture/harness assets. Verify project, coverage, tools/settings/check compatibility and current byte identity; author I alone is insufficient. Recover current evidence where feasible without relabeling edited bytes as before state. Same-session authors retain SELF_CHECK_ONLY. Review permits only the authorized new numbered report and fresh measurement siblings, with no source/index edits, implicit setup or cross-installation fallback.

provides.name: proportionate-rationale-disposition
provides.summary: Verify affected responsibilities through diff and local context, including rename/extraction helpers, rather than file membership or line movement. Dispose of new/newly crossed, worsening and materially edited retained breaches, naming known report/function/metric values, cohesion and alternative cost. Below/equal-target growth and untouched debt require no individual defense. Agreement can retain a justified breach; correction requires a concrete maintenance problem or hard-rule violation. Unknown counts remain unknown, and lower metrics do not excuse worse ownership, names or navigation.

provides.name: native-evidence-consumption-and-recovery
provides.summary: Review retains native command, whole governed scope, policy, requiredness, owner/stage, checked bytes, result and producer. Validate current saved proof or recover through its owner/authorized focused execution, respecting stricter reviewer-run architecture policy. Aggregate reuse requires established constituent coverage, scope, policy and current bytes. Missing required proof and hard failures remain distinct from advisory status; no new static command, registry requirement, review stage or functional review is introduced.

provides.name: downstream-maintainability-evidence-handoff
provides.summary: Discovery and separate acceptance validate current numbered review scope/bytes, reviewer comparison, dispositions, native coverage and remaining gaps without repeating general maintainability review. Preserve finding IDs and distinct evidence/correction/decision owners. Name the first outstanding stage and full applicable remainder: affected conditional duties, outstanding registry synchronization, fresh discovery, then separate acceptance. Omit only absent/current unaffected stages; significant test/eval/harness corrections stale affected proof. Naming a route executes no downstream stage.

artifacts.name: independent-comparison-reference
artifacts.summary: Reviewer-owned fresh R JSON/text paths accompany original B and author I, governed/affected scope, source identity, tool/settings/check completeness, gaps and recovery owner. Preserve every pair; isolated review transfers both siblings with exact source/receiving paths because ignored reports do not travel in commits. The portable measurement record owns report production and format.

artifacts.name: numbered-maintainability-review-and-dispositions
artifacts.summary: Existing numbered review reports carry measurement status/references, current reviewed scope/bytes, every rationale disposition, native evidence, gaps/owners and the complete outstanding route. Required dispositions, gaps and confirmed blockers stay outside the optional three-warning cap. Genuine stops retain outstanding coverage. ACCEPT binds reviewed maintainability bytes only; it cannot close missing mandatory proof or certify functional acceptance. Corrections preserve surviving/resolved finding IDs and reconcile the whole ledger.

artifacts.name: review-native-check-evidence-reference
artifacts.summary: The review and downstream handoff retain existing native policy and current execution evidence with whole-scope coverage, command, checked-byte identity, result and producer/stage. Required failures and stale/missing proof retain their owner and recovery route regardless of successful/N/A advisory measurement. This is evidence consumption, not a new evidence store or check policy.

artifacts.name: independent-review-eval-preparation
artifacts.summary: Opt-in actor definitions and a finite catalog prepare 82 unique selectable variants across 62 scenario IDs, with real comparison/native inputs, preserved histories and held-back artifact oracles. Setup reuses existing fixtures through an explicit source distribution and prepared pinned interpreter; installation targets only disposable authorized roots and never provisions dependencies. The local checker rejects duplicate dispatch IDs and truncated returned case fields, exercises all preparations and selected real comparison/native/correction controls. It executes no actor and supplies no live verdict/disposition/route qualification; T-005 complete installed composition remains separate.

invariants.statement: Metrics are advisory; justified breaches can be accepted and bare thresholds cannot request correction. Required native failures and missing mandatory proof retain their own policy and owner.
Keep original pre-edit B and every historical pair through corrections. Preserve source/index and authorized write boundaries; never recapture edited bytes as original or implicitly install tools.

Applicability requires compatible project/coverage/tool/settings/check identities and current submitted bytes. Unknown counts remain unknown; stale/incomplete/uncovered evidence cannot claim a clean comparison.
Independent review requires a fresh session and its own comparison; author self-checks and prepared fixture histories do not establish independent review. Native policy remains authoritative.
Rationale follows actually affected responsibilities and concrete maintenance cost, not untouched debt, formatting or threshold compliance alone.
Changed bytes stale affected verdicts and proof; retain stable finding identities and conditional stage order through fresh discovery and separate acceptance. Advisory warnings add no stage.
